name: Exhibit
description: Shows interactive exhibits the agent writes (dashboards, calculators, checklists, charts) in a sandboxed browser tab, with versions and saved data.

display_description.en: Lets WorkSwarm build exhibits for you: interactive pages like dashboards, calculators, checklists, forms, charts and small games, opened in a sandboxed browser tab. Exhibits keep their versions and can save what you enter, which WorkSwarm can read back. Exhibits can't reach the internet or your files. Version 0.1.0 prototype.
display_description.zh: 版本 0.1.0 原型。让 WorkSwarm 为你制作展品：可交互的页面，如仪表盘、计算器、清单、表单、图表和小游戏，并在沙盒浏览器标签页中打开。展品会保留各个版本，并能保存你填写的内容，WorkSwarm 可以读回这些内容。展品无法访问互联网或你的文件。

default_init_input.en: Make me an interactive monthly budget planner I can fill in.
default_init_input.zh: 帮我做一个可以填写的交互式月度预算规划页面。

quick_inputs.en: Make me an interactive monthly budget planner I can fill in.
quick_inputs.zh: 帮我做一个可以填写的交互式月度预算规划页面。

quick_inputs.en: Build a packing checklist for my trip that remembers what I've checked off.
quick_inputs.zh: 为我的旅行做一个打包清单，并记住我勾选了哪些。

quick_inputs.en: Turn this table into an interactive chart I can filter.
quick_inputs.zh: 把这个表格变成一个可以筛选的交互式图表。

display_description.en: Saves exhibits and their versions, opens them in a sandboxed browser tab and reads back what the user saved.
display_description.zh: 保存展品及其各个版本，在沙盒浏览器标签页中打开，并读回用户保存的内容。

display_description.en: Before a new exhibit is shown, asks whether you want an exhibit or an answer in chat, unless you asked for an exhibit.
display_description.zh: 在展示新展品前，询问你想要展品还是在对话中回答；如果你已明确要求展品则不再询问。
